resources.string: Wait for installation or the dependency check to finish.
Exit the game before starting a dedicated server on this phone.
Download the Build 41 multiplayer libraries in Additional libraries first.

Runs without a local player. You may close this panel and turn off the screen; use Save and stop to shut down. Choose an existing Host profile to continue its world, or a new name to create a world. Server files are in coop-probe/Server. Installed mods are shared when the hosting mods folder is empty; enable their IDs below. Long sessions and capacity are still being tested.
Load the selected profile before editing or starting.

Server is stopped. A completed save and shutdown were not confirmed; inspect the log.
Stop the dedicated server before launching the game or changing installed files.
The server has not finished. Force stopping may lose unsaved progress. Stop it immediately without waiting for a save?
